title: Aladdin Tower
visualBrief: Specific standing Aladdin mausoleum tower in Varamin: thirty-two sharp brick flutes, low conical brick cap, upper pointed corbel/blind-cell rhythm with sparse original geometric turquoise fragments, one small blind repair niche, projecting pale pointed entrance porch/stacked recesses/closed grilled doorway, and bounded buried footing. Four existing shared brick/stucco/tile/paint graphs; no copied calligraphy, photograph atlas, furnished tomb, assumed pristine full tile restoration, whole square or broad precinct slab.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained Q5808483/reference anchor51.645694444,35.324972222 is corroborated by native named memorial35184724139699 (Tower Alaeddin/برج علاالدوله) and its sole circular building part35184767745580. The memorial point belongs to the broader boundary, not the tower center. The16-point circle fixes center[-2.6724273110233048,-0.7492224800775424]m and mean radius5.728664827432449m. It is a generalized circular envelope, not measured flute peaks; Commons metadata reports12.14m external diameter, used as nominal peak diameter, with valleys chosen around the mapped mean radius. No exact native Wikidata tag is asserted. Global heading0/native east-south axes; approximate northwest porch phase-2.55rad follows the broad site extension/pictures, with45degree/3m uncertainty. A circle alone does not establish directed facade orientation.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Retained reported overall height26.71m has no point-of-measurement qualifier. The other16.11m statement is interior-qualified and is not used as exterior wall height. Picture-led nominal body/frieze shoulder20.1m, cone rise6.61m, upper frieze18.1..20.1m and porch7.6m guide the model. Parent map2m/circular-part7m values are unqualified component attributes, not adopted as total tower height. Roof/body split, flute depth, porch/repair niche, decorative/repair inventory and floor/foundation levels remain approximate.

The cropped ground photos and coarse DEM do not establish actual plaza/foundation engineering or a surveyed entrance azimuth.
